_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Preparing: send an invoice, quote or order

annotations.title: Propose: Send an invoice, quote or order

description: AI Agents: Use when asked: An invoice, quote or order emailed to the customer by the person's own system, from its own email address. The customer receives it, and only the person can approve it. Writes nothing: show it, and after a yes call apply_proposal (or share the approve link if needsApproval).

email.description: Send to this address instead of the one on the record.

id.description: The id of that record, order or campaign in the system.

item_kind.description: For an order or an email campaign, its kind instead of a type.

reminder.description: True to send the system's own payment reminder for an unpaid invoice instead of the invoice itself.

send_at.description: For an email campaign: when to send it, ISO 8601 in UTC; now when left out.

sign_off.description: True to send a quote for the customer to sign off online, where the system can.

type.description: The type of the record to send.

system.description: The AI agent: its system or connection name.

name: propose_send_record
